questions.question: What famous command appears in chapter 19?
options: "An eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth"
"Be fruitful and multiply and fill the earth"
"You shall have no other gods before me"

questions.question: How were farmers told to treat the edges of their fields and the leftover gleanings?
options: Leave them for the poor and the foreigner
Harvest every last bit of the grain
Burn the leftover stalks out in the open field
Sell the gleanings at the city gate
questions.answer: Leave them for the poor and the foreigner
